rules.instructions: Classify only the written occupation into the listed draft categories. Do not infer from name, religion, gender, income, or family members. Choose UNKNOWN for unreadable, contradictory, or insufficient text.

categories.SELF_EMPLOYED: Explicit self-employment, trade, tailoring, or own shop / स्वरोजगार
categories.DAILY_WAGE: Explicit daily wage work / दैनिक मजदूरी
categories.OTHER: Clearly stated occupation outside these categories
categories.UNKNOWN: Missing, unreadable, ambiguous, or insufficient occupation
